mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.3%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below 95 for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces earnings expectations for cyclicals and drags down the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their 6-month averages signals a dual tightening in monetary policy and inflation, which erodes real purchasing power and depresses equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.4%) in at least 55% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening employment, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 12mo MA for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on positive correlation between RSAFS and GDPC1 implies that rising personal savings coincide with expanding economic activity, supporting higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS and GDPC1 turns negative or S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.2%) when the correlation is above 0.6.
